en.t: 30 g coffee, ground medium-fine
500 g water, as hot as possible (especially for lighter roasts)

sk.t: 30 g káva, stredne jemne mletá
500 g voda čo najhorúcejšia (najmä pri svetlejšie pražených kávach)

en.t: 1. Weigh the coffee right before brewing and grind it fresh, on the slightly finer end of medium. Rinse the paper filter with the hottest water possible; this removes papery tastes and preheats the brewer.

2. Add the coffee to the centre of the V60 and make a small well in the middle of the grounds. Zero the scale and start the timer. With water as hot as possible (with a dark roast it is fine to wait 15–25 s after boiling), gently pour 60 g water (2 g water per gram of coffee, at most 3 to 1) to wet all the coffee.
3. Put the kettle down and swirl the brewer until the slurry looks evenly mixed. Let it bloom for up to 45 s.
4. Pour to 300 g total (60% of the water) within the next 30 s, so that it is in by 1:15.
5. Pour more slowly and gently, keeping the cone topped up, to 500 g total within the next 30 s (by 1:45).
6. Stir once clockwise and once anticlockwise with a spoon. Let it drain a little, then give one final gentle swirl so the bed stays flat, and let it draw down completely.

sk.t: 1. Kávu odvážime tesne pred prípravou a čerstvo ju zomelieme, o niečo jemnejšie ako na stredné mletie. Papierový filter prepláchneme čo najhorúcejšou vodou; odstráni sa papierová príchuť a prekvapkávač sa zohreje.

2. Kávu nasypeme do stredu V60 a v strede vytvoríme malú jamku. Váhu vynulujeme a spustíme časovač. Vodou čo najhorúcejšou (pri tmavo pražených kávach môžeme po zovretí počkať 15 – 25 s) jemne nalejeme 60 g vody (2 g vody na gram kávy, najviac v pomere 3 : 1), aby sa navlhčila všetka káva.
3. Kanvicu odložíme a prekvapkávačom krúžime, kým zmes nevyzerá rovnomerne premiešaná. Necháme ju predvlhčiť najviac 45 s.
4. V ďalších 30 s dolejeme vodu na celkových 300 g (60 % vody), aby bola naliata do 1:15.
5. Pomalšie a jemnejšie, aby bol kužeľ stále plný, dolejeme vodu na celkových 500 g v ďalších 30 s (do 1:45).
6. Lyžicou raz zamiešame v smere hodinových ručičiek a raz proti nemu. Necháme trochu odkvapkať, potom ešte raz jemne zakrúžime, aby vrstva kávy zostala rovná, a necháme úplne pretiecť.

5. Pomalšie a jemnejšie, aby bol kužeľ stále plný, dolejeme vodu na celkových 500 g v ďalších 30 s (do 1:45).
6. Lyžicou raz zamiešame v smere hodinových ručičiek a raz proti nemu. Necháme trochu odkvapkať, potom ešte raz jemne zakrúžime, aby vrstva kávy zostala rovná, a necháme úplne pretiecť.

en.t: 1. In a large, nonreactive vessel, combine ground coffee and water, stirring to fully saturate all the coffee grounds. Cover and let stand at room temperature for at least 8 and up to 12 hours.

2. Strain the cold brew concentrate through a fine-mesh strainer lined with cheesecloth or a large coffee filter or other filtering medium to remove grounds and sediment. Transfer cold brew concentrate to an airtight container and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled.
3. To serve, pour the chilled cold brew concentrate over ice and dilute to taste with cold water, milk, or a milk substitute.

en.t: 1. Set a carafe large enough to hold 475 ml of brewed coffee on a digital scale and tare scale to zero. Add 225 g ice. Set a dripper cone on top. Line with paper filter and add the ground coffee. Tare scale to zero once more.

2. Pour just enough near-boiling water onto grounds to wet them, then let stand 30 seconds (this is called blooming the coffee and will improve the flavor of the final brew). Resume pouring near-boiling water all over grounds until the scale reads 225 g. Allow water to fully drain through filter, then discard used coffee grounds. Serve iced coffee right away.

Použite lacnú vietnamskú robustu alebo zmes robusty a arabiky (ideálne 70 : 30); ak si melete sami, zvoľte stredne jemné mletie. Použite filtrovanú alebo balenú vodu tesne po zovretí, asi 95 °C.

en.t: 3 tbsp (18 g) Trung Nguyen Premium Blend
120 ml freshly boiled filtered water or bottled water
2 tbsp (30 ml) sweetened condensed milk, Longevity Brand (Sữa Ông Thọ)
113 g of ice for serving, plus more as desired

1. Remove lid and metal screen from phin filter. Add ground coffee to brewing chamber and shake gently to distribute evenly. Gently push the screen back on until you meet some resistance. (Don’t push the screen all the way down, as it will take longer for coffee to drip and result in an extra strong brew.)

2. Place lid underneath filter and set on a plate large enough to hold the filter and lid so it can catch any spilled coffee. Add 60 ml hot water and let steep until coffee grounds have absorbed all the water and turn black, about 5 minutes. While coffee steeps, place condensed milk into a glass big enough to hold all the coffee.

3. Place filter over glass containing condensed milk. Pour in remaining 60 ml hot water and any coffee that seeped out during steeping process. Allow coffee to drip until all liquid has drained, 7 to 10 minutes. (If it stops dripping because the screen was screwed on too tightly, gently loosen the screen.) Remove filter. Stir coffee and sweetened condensed milk to combine. Add ice, stir, and serve immediately.

1. Z filtra phin zložíme vrchnák a kovové sitko. Mletú kávu nasypeme do komory a jemne zatrasieme, aby sa rovnomerne rozložila. Sitko jemne zatlačíme späť, kým nepocítime odpor. (Sitko netlačíme úplne nadol, inak by káva kvapkala dlhšie a bola by mimoriadne silná.)

2. Vrchnák položíme pod filter a postavíme na tanierik dosť veľký na filter aj vrchnák, aby zachytil prípadne rozliatu kávu. Prilejeme 60 ml horúcej vody a necháme lúhovať, kým káva nenasaje všetku vodu a nesčernie, asi 5 minút. Kým káva lúhuje, dáme kondenzované mlieko do pohára, do ktorého sa zmestí všetka káva.

3. Filter postavíme na pohár s kondenzovaným mliekom. Nalejeme zvyšných 60 ml horúcej vody a kávu, ktorá pri lúhovaní pretiekla. Necháme kávu kvapkať, kým všetka tekutina nepretečie, 7 až 10 minút. (Ak prestane kvapkať, lebo je sitko príliš utiahnuté, jemne ho povolíme.) Filter odstránime. Kávu so sladeným kondenzovaným mliekom premiešame. Pridáme ľad, premiešame a ihneď podávame.

time.en: 15 min | Cook: not given | Total: 15 min

en.v: Chai reheats very well the next day.

sk.v: Chai sa na druhý deň veľmi dobre ohrieva.

c.t: Add only 1 or 2 spices, or they overpower the chai; cardamom is a good start. Saffron is added after the boil, during resting.
Pridajte len 1 alebo 2 koreniny, inak čaj prebijú; dobrý začiatok je kardamóm. Šafran sa pridáva až po prevarení, počas lúhovania.

en.t: 300 ml water
2 tsp (5 g) Premium or Gold CTC black tea leaves
2 tsp (10 g) granulated sugar

Any one or two of the following spices/flavorings: one lightly crushed 2.5 cm knob fresh ginger (about 14 g); 2 lightly crushed cardamom pods; 2 lightly crushed cloves; one lightly crushed 5 cm stick cinnamon
240 ml whole milk

1. In a 1890 ml saucepan, bring the 295 ml water to a simmer over medium-high heat. Add tea, sugar, and the spices/flavorings you have selected from the list. For a light chai, allow the mix to boil until the extract is reddish brown and lightly aromatic, about 2 minutes. For a stronger chai, allow the mixture to boil until the extract is darker, thicker, and more aromatic, about 5 minutes.

2. Add milk to chai mixture, return to a boil, then set a timer for 5 minutes. While the timer is counting down, allow the chai to rise up in the saucepan until it almost boils over, then reduce heat and allow it to fall back down into the pot. Increase the heat and repeat this process of almost boiling over 3 more times. Finally, reduce heat to a gentle simmer for the remainder of the 5-minute timer.
3. Remove chai from heat, cover with a lid, and allow it to stand for 5 minutes. Strain through a fine-mesh strainer and serve immediately.

1. V 1890 ml hrnci privedieme 295 ml vody na stredne silnom ohni do mierneho varu. Pridáme čaj, cukor a vybrané koreniny a príchute zo zoznamu. Pre jemný chai necháme zmes variť, kým výluh nie je červenohnedý a jemne voňavý, asi 2 minúty. Pre silnejší chai ju necháme variť, kým výluh nie je tmavší, hustejší a voňavejší, asi 5 minút.

2. K čajovej zmesi pridáme mlieko, znova privedieme do varu a nastavíme časovač na 5 minút. Počas odpočítavania necháme chai v hrnci vystúpiť, kým takmer nevykypí, potom stiahneme oheň a necháme ho klesnúť späť. Zvýšime oheň a takéto takmer vykypenie zopakujeme ešte 3-krát. Nakoniec stiahneme oheň a do konca 5 minút necháme mierne vrieť.
3. Chai stiahneme z ohňa, prikryjeme pokrievkou a necháme 5 minút postáť. Precedíme cez jemné sitko a ihneď podávame.

src: Serious Eats — "Cheese Foam Tea" (black milk-tea base with brown-sugar tapioca pearls)

time.en: 10 min | Cook: 60 min | Total: 70 min

en.v: The tea can be prepared in advance and refrigerated for up to 2 days. Tapioca pearls, if using, should be made the day of because cooked pearls don’t have a long shelf life and will harden when they cool down.

sk.v: Čaj môžeme pripraviť vopred a uchovávať v chladničke až 2 dni. Tapiokové perly, ak ich používame, pripravíme v deň podávania, pretože uvarené perly dlho nevydržia a po vychladnutí stvrdnú.

en.t: 6 tbsp (12 g) loose-leaf black tea, or 4 tea bags
Coarse raw sugar, such as demerara, to taste
180 g dried black tapioca pearls (often labeled as boba)
200 g coarse raw sugar, such as demerara
6 tbsp (90 ml) whole milk
2 tbsp (30 g) full-fat cream cheese
237 ml heavy cream
2 tbsp (30 g) granulated sugar
1 tsp (3 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table or fine sea salt, use half as much by volume or the same weight

1. For the Tea: In a 2840 ml saucepan, bring 1660 ml of water to a rolling boil over high heat. Turn off heat, add tea, cover, and let stand until water turns amber red, about 5 minutes. Strain tea (or remove tea bags) into a heatproof pitcher. Whisk in raw sugar to taste, cover, and refrigerate until cold.

2. For the Tapioca Pearls (if using): In a 1890 ml saucepan, bring 1420 ml of water to a rolling boil over high heat. Add tapioca pearls and cook, stirring occasionally, until all of the pearls float and turn completely brown with no white starchy bits in the center (timing can vary depending on the product; follow package cooking times for guidance). Turn off heat, cover, and let stand for 30 minutes.

3. Meanwhile, in a small pot, heat raw sugar and 235 ml water over low heat and cook, stirring, until sugar is completely dissolved. Turn off heat, cover simple syrup, and set aside. Once tapioca pearls are ready, drain pearls through a fine-mesh strainer, then add to pot with simple syrup. Cover and keep warm.
4. For the Cheese Foam: In a small bowl, combine milk and cream cheese. Using a small whisk or the back of a spoon, blend the cream cheese into the milk until no lumps remain.

5. In a medium bowl, combine cream, granulated sugar, and salt, and, using a hand mixer or a manual balloon whisk, beat at medium speed or whisk until frothy and sugar is fully dissolved, about 30 seconds. Beat or whisk in cream cheese mixture until light and airy like sea foam and still able to just barely flow, about 1 minute.

6. To serve, divide tapioca pearls (if using) between chilled tall glasses, add ice (if desired), and pour in chilled black tea. Top each glass with a couple dollops of cheese foam. If desired, add a thick straw or a long, thin spoon to scoop up the pearls. Serve immediately.

1. Čaj: v 2840 ml hrnci privedieme 1660 ml vody na silnom ohni do prudkého varu. Vypneme oheň, pridáme čaj, prikryjeme a necháme postáť, kým voda nie je jantárovočervená, asi 5 minút. Čaj precedíme (alebo vyberieme vrecúška) do žiaruvzdorného džbánu. Podľa chuti zašľaháme trstinový cukor, prikryjeme a necháme v chladničke vychladiť.

2. Tapiokové perly (ak ich používame): v 1890 ml hrnci privedieme 1420 ml vody na silnom ohni do prudkého varu. Pridáme tapiokové perly a za občasného miešania varíme, kým všetky perly nevyplávajú a úplne nezhnednú, bez bieleho škrobového jadierka v strede (čas sa líši podľa výrobku; riadime sa časom na obale). Vypneme oheň, prikryjeme a necháme 30 minút postáť.

3. Medzitým v malom hrnci na miernom ohni zohrievame trstinový cukor s 235 ml vody a miešame, kým sa cukor úplne nerozpustí. Vypneme oheň, cukrový sirup prikryjeme a odložíme. Keď sú perly hotové, scedíme ich cez jemné sitko a pridáme do hrnca so sirupom. Prikryjeme a udržiavame v teple.
4. Syrová pena: v malej miske zmiešame mlieko s krémovým syrom. Malou metličkou alebo chrbtom lyžice rozmiešame syr v mlieku, kým nezostanú žiadne hrudky.

5. V strednej mise zmiešame smotanu, kryštálový cukor a soľ a ručným šľahačom alebo balónovou metličkou šľaháme na strednej rýchlosti, kým zmes nie je penová a cukor sa úplne nerozpustí, asi 30 sekúnd. Zašľaháme syrovú zmes, kým pena nie je ľahká a vzdušná ako morská pena a ešte len-len tečie, asi 1 minútu.

6. Pri podávaní rozdelíme tapiokové perly (ak ich používame) do vychladených vysokých pohárov, pridáme ľad (podľa chuti) a nalejeme vychladený čierny čaj. Na každý pohár dáme niekoľko lyžíc syrovej peny. Ak chceme, pridáme hrubú slamku alebo dlhú tenkú lyžičku na naberanie perál. Ihneď podávame.

en.t: 1. Combine 59 ml boiling water and tea in bowl, then immediately pour off and discard water, reserving tea leaves.

2. Stir remaining 945 ml boiling water, washed tea, mint, and sugar in 1420 ml teapot or liquid measuring cup until sugar has dissolved. Cover and let steep for 5 minutes. Working in continuous motion, slowly pour tea into cups while lifting spout of pot away from cups to increase the length and arc of tea stream; return spout of pot to each cup before moving to next cup. Serve immediately with extra mint, if desired.

en.t: 1 medium banana (ripe, about 115 g), peeled and cut crosswise into eight pieces
830 ml berries (about 455 g)
120 ml whole milk
120 ml white cranberry juice or apple juice
pinch table salt
1 tbsp (12 g) granulated sugar, plus extra for desired sweetness
1 tsp (5 ml) lemon juice, plus extra as desired
3 ice cubes (about 43 g total)

1. Line rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper; arrange banana and berries in single layer on baking sheet. Freeze fruit until very cold, but not frozen, about 10 minutes. In blender, puree cold fruit, milk, juice, salt, 1 tbsp (15 ml) sugar, 1 tsp (5 ml) lemon juice, and ice until uniformly smooth, 10 to 15 seconds. Taste for sugar and lemon; if desired, add more sugar or lemon and blend until combined, about 2 seconds longer. Serve immediately.

time.en: 5 min | Cook: 15 min | Total: 50 min

en.t: 905 g rhubarb, chopped 0.5 cm thick
235 ml white wine vinegar
200 g granulated sugar
1. Combine the rhubarb, white wine vinegar, and granulated sugar in a small saucepan over medium-high heat, stirring as the rhubarb begins to break down.
2. When the mixture comes to a boil, reduce heat to low and cook until the rhubarb is completely broken down into strands, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

3. Remove from heat and pour into a colander or fine mesh strainer lined with a layer of cheesecloth. Allow the mixture to strain until it stops dripping, about 30 minutes. You can stir the mixture gently once or twice to help it strain, but do not press it through the cheesecloth. Discard the solids.

1. Pack tea leaves into a tea filter bag or tea ball infuser.
2. In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil over high heat. Add tea bag and continue to boil until the color of the tea is a rich amber, about 2 minutes.

3. Pour evaporated creamer (or heavy cream) and 1 tbsp (15 ml) condensed milk (if using evaporated creamer) or 1 1/2 tbsp (22 ml) condensed milk (if using heavy cream) into the tea and continue to boil, occasionally swirling the pan gently, for 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
4. Remove and discard the tea bag. Pour half of the tea into a kole, second saucepan or a large heatproof measuring cup.

Then pour the tea from the mug back into the saucepan. Continue to do this at least three more times, lifting the pouring vessel higher and higher each time to "stretch" or "pull" the tea during each transfer; the tea should become frothy. Finish with the tea in the mug, then repeat the pulling process with the second vessel of tea and mug. Serve hot.

sk.v: Sujeonggwa môžeme pripraviť vopred a uchovávať v chladničke v uzatvárateľnej nádobe až 3 dni. Pred podávaním ho ohrejeme na miernom ohni.

en.t: 5 cinnamon sticks
1420 ml water
200 g dark brown sugar (packed)
8 whole cloves
2 star anise pods
170 g fresh ginger (about three 7.5 cm pieces), peeled and thinly sliced
85 g dried apple chips
3 tbsp (30 g) pine nuts

1. Using tongs and working one at a time, lightly char cinnamon sticks by holding them over open flame of a gas burner or kitchen torch until lightly singed on both sides, 15 to 30 seconds each. Alternatively, if you don't have a gas burner, char cinnamon sticks in a dry cast iron skillet over high heat, about 10 minutes.

2. In a 2840 ml saucepan, combine charred cinnamon sticks, water, brown sugar, cloves, star anise, and ginger. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally with a rubber spatula to help brown sugar dissolve, then reduce heat to a gentle simmer. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until mixture is intensely aromatic and sugar is fully dissolved, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in apple chips, cover, and set aside to steep for 20 minutes.

3. Strain punch through a fine-mesh strainer, gently pressing on solids to extract as much liquid as possible; discard solids. If serving right away, return punch to saucepan and reheat over low heat until warmed through. Divide punch between individual mugs, sprinkle with pine nuts, and serve. If making tea in advance, allow to cool to room temperature, then refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat over low heat before serving.

480 ml freshly boiled water

60 ml evaporated milk

1. In a 945 ml heat-proof jar or container, combine Thai tea powder and 475 ml freshly boiled water, stirring to mix well. Steep until tea is aromatic and a dark reddish brown, about 5 minutes.

2. Stir tea to move settled tea leaves back into the liquid. Strain tea through cloth tea strainer fitted over a 945 ml heat-proof jar or container, pulling the bag up and out of the liquid as you go to release any excess tea. Alternatively, set a fine-mesh strainer over a medium bowl; line fine-mesh strainer with cheesecloth. Strain tea through cheesecloth, pulling the cheesecloth together and squeezing to release any excess tea. Remove cloth tea strainer or cheesecloth and set aside.

3. While tea is still warm, stir in sugar, condensed milk, evaporated milk, and salt. Season to taste with additional condensed milk, evaporated milk, sugar, and salt as needed. Refrigerate tea until completely cool, about 1 hour.
4. Fill two 350 ml glasses with ice. Pour chilled tea over ice and serve immediately.

c.t: The amounts of water and sugar set the thickness and sweetness; as written the drink is fairly thick and mildly sweet. Add more water for a thinner drink.
Množstvo vody a cukru určuje hustotu a sladkosť; podľa receptu je nápoj dosť hustý a mierne sladký. Pre redší nápoj pridajte viac vody.

en.t: 120 ml masa harina para tortillas
710 ml water, plus more as needed, divided
235 ml milk
3 (2.5 cm) strips orange zest from 1 large orange
2 star anise pods (optional)
3 tbsp (36 g) dark brown sugar
Kosher salt
Finely grated orange zest, for garnish

1. In a large saucepan, add masa and set over medium heat. Immediately add water in a slow, thin stream while whisking constantly to avoid lumps. Bring to a simmer and whisk in milk, orange zest strips, star anise (if using), brown sugar, and a generous pinch of salt.

2. Return to a simmer and lower heat to low. Continue to simmer gently, whisking constantly, until drink is infused with the orange aroma, about 5 minutes. Discard orange zest strips and star anise pods. Thin with additional water, as needed, to create a thick-yet-drinkable hot beverage (the exact consistency is a matter of personal taste), reheating as necessary. Taste, adding more sugar or salt if desired. Froth with a whisk or immersion blender, then ladle into mugs, garnish with grated orange zest and serve.

en.t: 1300 g lemons (10 to 14 medium lemons)
400 g sugar
945 ml cold-brewed black tea

1. Bring lemons to room temperature, then roll firmly against the counter to soften their rinds. Halve and juice; pour juice into a sealable container and refrigerate. Cut rinds into 2.5 cm chunks. Toss with sugar in a large nonreactive mixing bowl, cover tightly with plastic, and let stand at room temperature, stirring once every 45 minutes or so, until sugar has completely dissolved, about 3 hours. (You can let the mixture stand up to 12 hours, if desired.)

2. Add 225 g (235 ml) of reserved lemon juice to rind mixture. Stir well, then strain through a nonreactive fine-mesh strainer or piece of cheesecloth into a glass or ceramic container; discard rinds. At this point, the concentrated lemonade can be refrigerated for up to 1 week.
3. When ready to serve, pour concentrated lemonade and cold-brewed tea into a pitcher and stir. Serve in ice-filled glasses.

en.v: medium Dutch oven or saucepan, wooden spoon, mesh strainer, cheesecloth

sk.v: Stredne veľký liatinový hrniec alebo kastról, drevená varecha, sitko, gáza

en.t: 945 ml water (from the method)
115 g piloncillo, roughly chopped
2 Ceylon cinnamon sticks
1 clove
1 star anise pod
6 tbsp (89 ml) freshly ground dark-roast coffee

1. Bring 945 ml of water to a boil in a medium Dutch oven or saucepan, uncovered, over medium-high heat. Reduce the heat until the water just boils. Carefully add the piloncillo, cinnamon sticks, clove and star anise. Stir occasionally with a wooden spoon for about 5 minutes. Turn off the heat, add the ground coffee and stir. Cover the pan and let the mixture steep for 7 minutes.
2. Strain the coffee through a mesh strainer lined with cheesecloth. Enjoy the café de olla hot.

1. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment (you can also do this in a mixing bowl with a hand-mixer), combine the instant coffee granules, granulated sugar, and hot water. time.en: 15 min | Cook: not given | Total: not given

en.v: Cheesecloth or nonreactive fine-mesh strainer, 2000 ml pitcher

sk.v: Gáza alebo nereaktívne jemné sitko, džbán 2000 ml

en.v: The limeade concentrate can be refrigerated for up to 1 week.

sk.v: Limetkový koncentrát môžete uchovávať v chladničke až 1 týždeň.

en.t: 1300 g limes (12 to 16 medium limes)
400 g sugar
700 ml cold water

1. Bring limes to room temperature, then roll firmly against the counter to soften their rinds. Halve and juice; set juice aside. Cut rinds into 2.5 cm chunks. Toss with sugar in a large nonreactive mixing bowl, cover tightly with plastic, and let stand at room temperature, stirring once every 45 minutes or so, until sugar has completely dissolved, about 3 hours. (You can let the mixture stand up to 12 hours, if desired.)

2. Add water and 180 ml of reserved lime juice. Stir well, then strain through a nonreactive fine-mesh strainer or piece of cheesecloth into a glass or ceramic container. At this point, the concentrated limeade can be refrigerated for up to 1 week.

3. When ready to serve, pour limeade over ice and adjust to taste with additional water or lime juice, depending on personal preference; bear in mind, though, that the limeade will be diluted as the ice melts. (You will likely have some fresh lime juice left over, which can be reserved for another use, though exactly how much you have will depend on how much you added to adjust the limeade.)

1. Limetky necháme zohriať na izbovú teplotu a potom ich pevne pováľame po linke, aby zmäkla šupka. Prekrojíme a vytlačíme; šťavu odložíme. Šupky nakrájame na 2,5 cm kúsky. Vo veľkej nereaktívnej mise ich premiešame s cukrom, pevne prikryjeme fóliou a necháme pri izbovej teplote, zhruba každých 45 minút premiešame, kým sa cukor úplne nerozpustí, asi 3 hodiny. (Ak chceme, môžeme zmes nechať postáť až 12 hodín.)

2. Pridáme vodu a 180 ml odloženej limetkovej šťavy. Dobre premiešame a precedíme cez nereaktívne jemné sitko alebo gázu do sklenenej či keramickej nádoby. V tejto fáze môžeme koncentrovanú limetkovú limonádu skladovať v chladničke najviac 1 týždeň.

3. Pri podávaní nalejeme limonádu na ľad a podľa chuti upravíme ďalšou vodou alebo limetkovou šťavou; pamätajme však, že roztápajúci sa ľad limonádu zriedi. (Pravdepodobne nám zostane trochu čerstvej limetkovej šťavy na iné použitie; koľko, závisí od toho, koľko sme jej pridali pri dochucovaní.)

time.en: 5 min | Cook: 5 min | Total: 10 min

en.t: 235 ml cold milk
1 1/2 tsp (4 g) Dutch-process cocoa powder
3/4 tsp (3 g) honey (or 1 1/2 tsp (6 g) granulated sugar)
1. In a microwave-safe container, heat 59 ml of the milk until steaming, about 15 seconds.
2. Add the cocoa powder and honey (or sugar) to the hot milk, and stir vigorously until all the lumps are gone.
3. Transfer the cocoa mix into your glass of choice, and fill with the remaining cold milk. Enjoy!

Scaling: making more servings does not change the caffeine in each serving; what counts is how many servings she drinks in a day. 1 serving: 3 mg · 2 servings: 6 mg · 3 servings: 9 mg · 4 servings: 12 mg.

src: America's Test Kitchen — Afton Cyrus — "Ginger Ale"

time.en: not given | Cook: not given | Total: 50 min

en.v: The ginger syrup can be refrigerated for up to 1 week.

sk.v: Zázvorový sirup môžete uchovávať v chladničke až 1 týždeň.

en.t: 115 g fresh ginger
355 ml water
99 g sugar
170 g honey
Pinch table salt
59 ml lime juice, squeezed from 2 limes
Ice
175 ml cold plain seltzer water
1. For the ginger syrup: Slice ginger crosswise 0.5 cm thick. You should have about 235 ml sliced ginger.
2. In medium saucepan, combine sliced ginger, water, sugar, honey, and salt. Bring to simmer over medium heat (small bubbles should break often across surface of mixture).
3. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally with wooden spoon, for 15 minutes. Turn off heat and slide saucepan to cool burner.
4. Stir in lime juice. Let mixture cool completely, about 30 minutes.

5. Line fine-mesh strainer with triple layer of cheesecloth. Place strainer over medium bowl. Pour cooled ginger mixture through strainer into bowl, pressing gently on ginger pieces to extract as much liquid as possible. Discard cheesecloth and ginger pieces. Pour strained ginger syrup into jar with tight-fitting lid. (Ginger syrup can be refrigerated for up to 1 week.)

6. To make 1 ginger ale: Stir or shake ginger syrup to recombine. Place ice in glass. Pour cold seltzer into glass over ice. Add 59 ml ginger syrup to seltzer. Use spoon to stir gently to combine. Serve.

c.t: 1. For the ginger syrup: Slice ginger crosswise 0.5 cm thick. You should have about 235 ml sliced ginger.
2. In medium saucepan, combine sliced ginger, water, sugar, honey, and salt. Bring to simmer over medium heat (small bubbles should break often across surface of mixture).
3. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally with wooden spoon, for 15 minutes. Turn off heat and slide saucepan to cool burner.
4. Stir in lime juice. Let mixture cool completely, about 30 minutes.

5. Line fine-mesh strainer with triple layer of cheesecloth. Place strainer over medium bowl. Pour cooled ginger mixture through strainer into bowl, pressing gently on ginger pieces to extract as much liquid as possible. Discard cheesecloth and ginger pieces. Pour strained ginger syrup into jar with tight-fitting lid. (Ginger syrup can be refrigerated for up to 1 week.)

6. To make 1 ginger ale: Stir or shake ginger syrup to recombine. Place ice in glass. Pour cold seltzer into glass over ice. Add 59 ml ginger syrup to seltzer. Use spoon to stir gently to combine. Serve.
1. Zázvorový sirup: zázvor nakrájame priečne na plátky hrubé 0,5 cm. Mali by sme mať asi 235 ml nakrájaného zázvoru.
2. V strednom hrnci zmiešame nakrájaný zázvor, vodu, cukor, med a soľ. Na strednom ohni privedieme do mierneho varu (na povrchu by mali často praskať drobné bublinky).
3. Stiahneme oheň na stredne slabý a za občasného miešania varechou varíme 15 minút. Vypneme oheň a hrniec presunieme na studenú platničku.
4. Vmiešame limetkovú šťavu. Zmes necháme úplne vychladnúť, asi 30 minút.

5. Jemné sitko vyložíme trojitou vrstvou gázy. Sitko postavíme nad strednú misu. Vychladnutú zázvorovú zmes precedíme do misy a kúsky zázvoru jemne pritlačíme, aby sme získali čo najviac tekutiny. Gázu so zázvorom vyhodíme. Precedený zázvorový sirup nalejeme do pohára s tesne priliehajúcim viečkom. (Zázvorový sirup vydrží v chladničke najviac 1 týždeň.)

6. Príprava 1 ginger ale: zázvorový sirup pretrepeme alebo premiešame. Do pohára dáme ľad. Na ľad nalejeme studenú sódovku. K sódovke pridáme 59 ml zázvorového sirupu. Lyžicou jemne premiešame. Podávame.

cat.en: Simmer the sliced ginger gently, with small bubbles breaking often; a hard boil makes the syrup harsh.
cat.sk: Nakrájaný zázvor varte jemne, aby často praskali len malé bublinky; pri prudkom vare bude sirup štipľavý.
